instruction: Set the default video playback quality to 4K for all YouTube videos.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome browser does not have settings to control YouTube's default video quality. Video quality preferences are managed by YouTube's website settings, not by Chrome browser settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly marked as infeasible - Chrome does not have settings to control YouTube video quality
